author: Vobaseball12
body:
Today, at 8:29 PM EST SpaceX will attempt to launch and land its Falcon 9 rocket on land. Why is this so special? This has never been done before. Earlier, SpaceX tried to land its Falcon 9 rocket on a barge in the ocean. Sadly, it tipped over during its landing and failed. 

Check it out here: http://www.livestream.com/SpaceX!
